task: Repair guide saved-route loading, verify planner controls, and show planning drafts in the dashboard Routes panel

best_fix: Reload the whole owned My Route and guide context; expose unsaved owned guide drafts as a separate dashboard Planning drafts section.
safest_fix: Fixing Load alone would be narrower but would leave planning drafts absent from the dashboard; the complete requested fix was implemented.
root_causes: Same-route Load only called the guide preview calculation, so unsaved values were not replaced by the stored route.
The dashboard queried generated loop_routes only; guide planning drafts remain user_routes until Save trip.
Guide refresh alone reloaded mileage without updating the left-hand stop list when the stored route changed elsewhere.
Create another copy remained enabled even though the current draft template could not be imported.
